title: Task READMEs: name pools and corpus limits in plain words
description: Extend the per-task README work so a reader can see the limits of each cue and corpus without a separate limitations page: the race-fullname pool sizes per group and sex (the smallest pool has ten first names), that the Asian first-name pool is drawn from the same source as the white pool, the published critique that distinctively group-associated first names also carry class and birth-cohort signal, and for the Bias in Bios tasks that gender was inferred from pronouns by the source paper (which interacts with a pronoun-swap cue), that occupation labels come from a title regex, and that the corpus is English and largely US-based. Each README should cite the sources for these points.
